# openobserve_alert_destination (Data Source)

Reads an existing alert destination. Headers are not returned, because they can carry credentials.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "openobserve_alert_destination" "existing_pagerduty" {
  name = "pagerduty"
}

resource "openobserve_alert" "example" {
  name         = "disk-pressure"
  stream_type  = "logs"
  stream_name  = "system"
  destinations = [data.openobserve_alert_destination.existing_pagerduty.name]

  query_condition {
    type = "sql"
    sql  = "SELECT count(*) AS total FROM \"system\" WHERE message LIKE '%disk pressure%'"
  }

  trigger_condition {
    period    = 10
    threshold = 1
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Destination name to look up.

### Optional

- `org_id` (String) Organization identifier. Defaults to the provider's `org_id`.

### Read-Only

- `aws_region` (String) AWS region of the SNS topic.
- `emails` (Set of String) Recipient addresses for email destinations.
- `id` (String) Data source ID in the format `{org_id}/{name}`.
- `method` (String) HTTP method used for webhook delivery.
- `skip_tls_verify` (Boolean) Whether TLS verification is skipped.
- `sns_topic_arn` (String) SNS topic ARN.
- `template` (String) Template used to render the message.
- `type` (String) Delivery channel.
- `url` (String) Webhook URL.
